exercises.task: Create a Book class with title and pages, plus a summary() method. Then run the test.
exercises.hint: The constructor sets this.title and this.pages; summary() returns a template string.

exercises.task: Add a static count of how many players exist. Then run the test.
exercises.hint: Inside the constructor, write Player.count++ — the class name, not this.

exercises.task: Make age private and add a setter that rejects negatives. Then run the test.
exercises.hint: Guard with if (n >= 0) before assigning to this.#age.
